articles.summary: In an independent randomized trial, AlloSure-based monitoring demonstrates a significant reduction in kidney transplant biopsies while maintaining similar clinical outcomes A multinational study shows AlloSure Kidney AlloSure Plus maintained strong rejection prediction under updated Banff 2024 pathology criteria CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today highlighted data featuring AlloSure® Kidney donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) being presented at the American Society of Nephrology (ASN) Kidney Week 2026, taking place October 22–25 in Denver, Colorado. The findings address several persistent challenges in kidney transplant management: determining the significance of ambiguous biopsy results, reducing reliance on invasive surveillance biopsies, and maintaining reliable rejection prediction as diagnostic criteria evolve.
